 Where Frost Children Are Playing In 2026 And 2027
 October 27, 2026 
 Key Tour Takeaways
 Frost Children’s North American headline run spans late October through mid-December 2026. Confirmed stops include Los Angeles, Chicago, Cleveland, Washington DC, Philadelphia, Boston, Denver, Salt Lake City, Seattle, Vancouver, Portland, San Francisco, and Austin.
 Portland’s show now takes place at Roseland Theater. Seattle and Denver have venue discrepancies across listings, and DC’s venue appears under multiple spellings of BERHTA.
 After the U.S. club dates, the band heads to New Zealand and Australia for Rhythm And Vines, Beyond The Valley, and Wildlands festivals from late December 2026 into early January 2027.
 The final confirmed date in this cycle is a DJ set at Igloofest Montreal on January 23, 2027, which closes the current routing.
 OnesToWatch Live provides verified primary ticket links and current routing details for Frost Children’s 2026–2027 tour.

 Frost Children Tour Dates 2026–2027: Full Upcoming Schedule
 Below is the complete upcoming schedule across North America, New Zealand, and Australia, with select dates carrying direct ticket links.

 November 14, 2026 — Frost Children [LiVE] headline BERHTA (1237 W Street NE, Washington, DC) with doors at 8:00 PM and support from Olswel. The venue name appears in multiple spellings across secondary sources, so check the official DC venue page before traveling.

 Leg 3: 2027 Outlook
 January 23, 2027 — Igloofest Montreal 2027, Old Port (Quai Jacques-Cartier), Montreal, QC — DJ set alongside Ninajirachi. This show is part of Igloofest’s 19th edition, running January 14 – February 6, 2027. Weekend 2 also includes Fatboy Slim on January 21 and KETTAMA on January 22.
 Additional Frost Children 2026 Context
 Frost Children, siblings Angel and Lulu Prost from St. Louis and now based in New York, curated and headlined Frost Fest 2026 on July 25, 2026 at Knockdown Center in Queens, NY. The sold-out event featured a nearly two-hour headlining set and a multi-song encore, plus an afterparty at SILO Brooklyn. Kim Petras made a guest appearance during the set, performing “RADIO,” “101,” and “Pop Sound.” Some outlets billed her appearance as a surprise, but it felt like the payoff the set had been building toward. The lineup was reworked at the last minute after international acts The Deep and The Femcels were denied US entry due to visa issues, and Frost Children brought in kimj and Pinponpanpon instead.
 The Tweaker Poem EP arrived July 10, 2026 via RCA Records. The duo wrote and recorded it in a single 24-hour session in Tokyo on January 2, 2026, sequencing the tracks in the order they were made. The December 2026 headline run follows directly from that release.
 Frost Children’s 2026 festival calendar included Ultra Miami, Electric Forest, Lollapalooza, Hinterland, HARD Summer, Outside Lands (two sets on August 9), Capitol Hill Block Party, Reading, and Hulaween (October 22–25). Additional December festival dates at Holiday Hootenanny, Beyond The Valley, Rhythm And Vines, and Wildlands extend that schedule across two continents before the North American club tour even begins.
 LineupScout’s artist-matching tool surfaces similar-bill suggestions based on shared festival lineups. These are algorithmic recommendations, not confirmed Frost Children bookings, and they should not be treated as announced dates.
 Patterns, Themes, And Takeaways
 The 2026–2027 routing forms a two-continent arc. Frost Children stack a dense North American club run through November and December, then move straight into a Southern Hemisphere summer festival circuit across New Zealand and Australia, and finally return to Montreal in late January 2027. The trajectory aligns with a band shifting from mid-capacity clubs toward festival-scale bookings. Beyond The Valley, for example, bills itself as Australia’s largest multi-day music festival and sold out its 10th anniversary edition in under an hour, a record surpassed by the 2026/27 edition, which sold out before general sale.
 Key routing details sit in a few specific places. Portland’s venue change to Roseland Theater is confirmed in the tour dates above. DC’s BERHTA listing appears with variant spellings across secondary sources. Seattle and Denver show conflicting venue names between Exclaim! and Gigvault/StubHub, so the official venue pages remain the final reference.
 The window to see Frost Children in a club setting is narrowing. The December North America dates take place in mid-capacity clubs and theaters, while the Australia and New Zealand shows are festival stages. The Montreal appearance is a DJ set at an outdoor winter festival expected to draw nearly 100,000 attendees. If you want to see the band in a club, this run is your last clear chance.
 Practical Reader Guidance
 For Portland, the official venue is Roseland Theater at 8 NW 6th Ave, Portland, OR 97209. Tickets are sold through Etix and Cascade Tickets, and the venue does not guarantee the validity of tickets purchased through secondary marketplaces. The GA floor is all ages, and the reserved balcony is 21+.
 For Washington, DC, the venue appears as BERHTA (Complex) across listings. Check the official venue page directly before traveling, since the name shows up in variant spellings on secondary sites.
 For Seattle and Denver, cross-reference the official venue page against the date before purchasing, because venue names differ across sources.
 Frost Children’s December 5, 2026 show at The Pearl in Vancouver is a legal age 19+ event, though at least one third-party listing site inconsistently states an 18+ age limit. The Pearl is located at 881 Granville Street, Vancouver, BC.
 For the Australia and New Zealand festival dates, early planning matters. Beyond The Valley’s 10th anniversary edition sold out in under an hour, and its 2026/27 edition sold out before general sale. Wildlands warned that general on-sale allocations were not guaranteed after presale. Check official festival sites for current availability.
 For all North American headline dates, primary ticketing offers the safest purchase path. Secondary market prices for Frost Children’s Chicago (November 12, 2026) and Lakewood (November 13, 2026) shows are elevated, with Chicago get-in prices starting at $50 (median $66) and TicketNetwork averages of $95.88 for Chicago and $162.44 for Lakewood. SeatData, however, characterizes demand for the Chicago date as low and prices as 18.9% below their all-time high.
 Frequently Asked Questions
 Are There Confirmed Frost Children Dates In 2027? 
 Yes. Three Frost Children dates fall in or span into 2027 across multiple sources: Wildlands Perth on January 2, 2027 at Arena Joondalup in Perth, Western Australia; Igloofest Montreal on January 23, 2027 at the Old Port in Montreal alongside Ninajirachi; and the Wildlands Brisbane New Year’s event running December 31, 2026 through January 1, 2027. The Igloofest appearance is part of the festival’s 19th edition, running January 14 through February 6, 2027. Additional 2027 headline dates beyond these festival appearances have not been widely reported.
 What Happened To The Portland Show At Wonder Ballroom? 
 The December 6, 2026 Portland show moved from Wonder Ballroom to Roseland Theater at 8 NW 6th Ave, Portland, OR 97209. Both the Wonder Ballroom and Roseland Theater event pages confirm the relocation. Tickets purchased for the Wonder Ballroom show remain valid at Roseland. The show is presented by Monqui Presents, with Kuru as support.
 Who Are The Confirmed Support Acts On The December 2026 Tour? 
 Kuru is confirmed as support for the December 5 Vancouver show at The Pearl and the December 6 Portland show at Roseland Theater. Olswel is confirmed as support for the November 15 Charlottesville show at Jefferson Theater. The Pearl on Granville’s event page bills the December 5, 2026 Vancouver show as “FROST CHILDREN with Special Guests” without naming additional supports, while some third-party listings name Kuru as support. Support acts for other dates on the run have not been publicly confirmed as of publication.
 What Is The DC Venue For Frost Children’s November 2026 Show? 
 The Washington, DC show on November 14, 2026 is listed at BERHTA, also styled “Berhta – Complex,” across multiple secondary sources. The venue name appears in variant spellings, so check the official DC venue page directly before purchasing tickets or making travel arrangements.
 Is The Montreal Igloofest Appearance A Full Live Show Or A DJ Set? 
 The January 23, 2027 Igloofest Montreal appearance is billed as a DJ set. Frost Children share the night with Australian producer Ninajirachi. The event is part of Igloofest Weekend 2, which also features Fatboy Slim on January 21 and KETTAMA on January 22. Tickets for Igloofest 2027 went on general sale October 23, 2026 via igloofest.ca.
 How Do I Buy Tickets For Frost Children’s Upcoming Shows? 
 Primary ticket links for the Salt Lake City, Vancouver, and San Francisco headline dates appear above through OnesToWatch Live. For other North American dates, check the official venue box office or Ticketmaster. For the Australia and New Zealand festival dates, visit the official festival sites, including wildlandsfestival.com.au for Wildlands Brisbane and Perth, and the Beyond The Valley and Rhythm And Vines official pages for those appearances. For Igloofest Montreal, tickets are available at igloofest.ca. Primary ticketing is recommended over secondary marketplaces.
 Conclusion: Why This Routing Matters
 Frost Children’s North American tour dates run through mid-December 2026, followed by Rhythm And Vines in Gisborne, New Zealand (December 28–31, 2026), Beyond The Valley in Australia (December 29, 2026), and Wildlands Perth (January 2, 2027), with an Igloofest Montreal appearance on January 23, 2027. The Portland venue change, DC venue spelling variations, and Seattle and Denver discrepancies are all noted above, and the Australia and New Zealand festival leg and Igloofest date round out the current picture. This guide consolidates the confirmed dates and venue details in one place.
 The December North America club run marks the final stretch of this routing in club-sized rooms. After that, the band’s appearances shift to festival stages in Australia and New Zealand and a large-scale outdoor winter festival in Montreal. The opportunity to catch Frost Children in a club setting sits in this run.
